data.summary_en: JANUS replaces Generate-Execute-Feedback with co-evolving-world-model-driven Predict-Verify-Evolve loop for long-horizon autonomous research. It predicts value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility pre-execution, selecting/refining/pruning branches; distills real feedback into hierarchical research-agent and world-model exploration-policy skills. On MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks, evolution-efficiency and upper-bound exceed SOTA baselines.
